Subject: Shared Close Roadmap & MAP Draft — NovaNet POC

Hi Eliza —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I promised to share a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an initial evaluation timeline so your team can align on milestones next week. I created a starting Google Doc and a one-slide timeline to keep the kickoff focused.

What I added to the MAP (high level):
- Objectives & success criteria (business + engineering)
- Key stakeholders and weekly cadence
- Technical checkpoints (data ingest, model selection, perf targets)
- Acceptance criteria for pilot sign-off

Please review the doc and add any missing stakeholders or constraints. Recommended next steps:
1) You add security/compliance contacts to the "RACI" section in the doc
2) We lock the initial run window (proposed Feb 9–20) on the slide and commit to a dry run one week prior
3) Your team fills the requirements matrix for data access and sample volume

Links/attachments: [attachment: NovaNet_MAP_Draft_v1.gdoc (Google Doc)], [attachment: POC_Timeline_v1.gslides (Slide)], [attachment: requirements_matrix.xlsx]

If useful I can also change the timeline to a two-week pilot instead of single sprint — just tell me which stakeholders must be present for the kickoff meeting.

Marissa

Marissa —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. I skimmed the MAP and it looks sensible. A few asks from our side before we share this broadly:
- Can you add a short security checklist itemizing evidence we’ll request during the pilot? Our InfoSec lead (cc'd when you share) will need to see it.
- Shift the pilot window to start Feb 16 if possible — product release dates mean our team is tight the week of 9th.
- Add a success metric for "mean inference latency under 350ms at 95th percentile" under the perf targets section.

I added two people who should be in the doc: ronda@novanet.com (Ronda Park, InfoSec) and miguel@novanet.com (Data Eng). I can edit directly if you give me edit access to the doc.

Marissa —

Nice start. Couple of internal suggestions before we push the doc externally:
- Add a short "model selection" row under Technical checkpoints with recommended starting models (open-llama-13b -> 8-bit quant) and an alternate fallback (redwood-small-ct) for cost gating.
- Make the Data Eng checkpoint explicit: sample size (min 10k rows) and schema contract deadline (COB Feb 2).
- Propose a canary schedule: Feb 16–18 internal dry runs, Feb 19–20 public pilot. If NovaNet prefers the later start we can compress internal dry run to Feb 13–15.

Also — include a one-line note on rate limits/cost expectations. I've attached a one-pager internally we can paste into the MAP (I put it in the Drive linked in the doc).
